result.stdout:
Usage: clip [options]

Cross-platform clipboard bridge — copy from stdin, paste to stdout, clear.

Options:
  -c, --copy   Force copy mode (read stdin to clipboard), overriding autodetect
  -p, --paste  Force paste mode (read clipboard to stdout), overriding autodetect
  --clear      Empty the clipboard, overriding autodetect
  -r, --raw    Do not strip trailing newline on paste
  --primary    Target X11/Wayland PRIMARY selection (Linux only; ignored elsewhere)
  -h, --help   Show help
  --version    Show version
  --color      Force colored output
  --no-color   Disable colored output
  --json       JSON output
  --describe   Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

Exit Codes:
  0    Success (including empty-clipboard paste)
  125  Invalid flags / conflicting modes / invalid UTF-8 input
  126  Clipboard busy or helper failure
  127  No clipboard helper found (Linux only)
